text:
Alex: quick poll — we fix a one-line YAML indent that breaks prod, is that a `patch` or do we order pizza to soothe the team? :thinking_face:
Priya: patch imo. pizza is for deploys that go REALLY wrong :pizza:
Mario: patch + emoji reaction. but can we also get garlic knots? :drooling_face:
Sasha: depends — was it a tab vs 2 spaces crime? if it was two spaces ➜ patch, if tab ➜ major existential crisis :eyes:
Alex: example offender:
```yaml
service:
	name: inference-runner
  replicas: 3
```
(notice the tab + two-space combo)
Priya: oh no. that mix is the stuff of legends. 
CI-Bot: build #482 failed on lint: yaml indentation error at line 2
Mario: classic. rename branch to `fix/yaml-indent-and-eat-pizza`? :laughing:
Sasha: make it a poll: "patch or pizza" — I'll vote pizza if we get evidence of extra mysterious semver changes (e.g. `version: 1..0`) :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Alex: ok quick doodle — reacting with :one: for patch, :two: for pizza
Priya: :one: (patch)
Mario: :two: (pizza)
Sasha: :one: but also :pizza: if someone admits they edited YAML in Notepad++
CI-Bot: rerun lint? kicked off pipeline #483
Alex: result: 2 votes patch, 1 vote pizza. Patch wins. Pizza postponed to next all-hands when someone accidentally semver-bumps a minor to major. :tada:
